_note: Registry of KNOWN pure-insertion conflicts between feat/menu-i18n and upstream main. resolve-rebase-conflicts.py refuses to touch any conflict that is not listed here, so a new upstream edit can never be silently dropped. When upstream adds code next to one of our hooks and rebase reports a NEW conflict, inspect it, confirm both sides are independent insertions (not two edits of the same line), then append an entry with the exact text of each side. Keep both sides verbatim, including whitespace and trailing newline. Chinese must be written as \uXXXX escapes so this file stays pure ASCII.
_how_to_add: 1) run: resolve-rebase-conflicts.py <conflicted-vk_menu.cpp> --dump  (prints each side as a JSON string); 2) copy those two strings into a new entry's ours/theirs; 3) add a short reason; 4) re-run without --dump. The tool re-checks byte equality on every run.
